text:
Once upon a time, there was a big orange cat. The cat had a friend, a little dog. They liked to play and run in the park. The cat would yawn when the dog played, and the dog would just sit.
One day, the cat said to the dog, "Let's play a game! We will run and jump, and you will catch me!" The dog wagged his tail and said, "Yes, let's play!"
They ran and played all day. The sun was very hot, and they were tired. They sat under a big tree to rest. The orange cat yawned and said, "I am so tired. Let's take a break." The dog agreed and they both took a break. They sat under the tree and took a nap, happy to have played their new game.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pretty purse that she loved very much. It was red and had a picture of a cat on it.
One day, Lily went to the park with her mom. She took her purse with her, but then she saw a little boy sitting on a bench. He looked very sad. Lily went to the boy and said, "Hi, I am Lily. Why are you sad?" The boy looked at her and said, "I lost my toy. I can't find it."
Lily wanted to help the boy, so she said, "Come with me. We will look for your toy together." They walked around the park, looking for the boy's toy. They looked under benches, behind trees, and even in the sandbox.
Then, Lily saw a distant tree with a small box. She opened the box and found her purse! She gave it to the boy and said, "Please, let's open the box and reveal what is inside." Inside the box, they found the boy's toy! The boy was so happy, and they both played together.
From that day on, Lily and the boy became good friends. They learned that helping others can make you happy too. And the purse became their favorite thing to share.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play hide and seek with her friends. One day, they played in a big park near their home. Lily found a great hiding spot behind a big tree.
Lily's friend, Tim, said, "Ready or not, here I come!" He looked and looked, but he could not find Lily. Then, Tim saw a little boy named Sam. Sam was hiding behind the big tree. He was laughing and said, "I found you!"
Lily and her friends laughed too. They all wanted to play hide and seek again. They went home, excited to play in the big park another day. And from that day on, the park was a much more fun place for Lily, her friends, and the little boy.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was an adorable little bunny named Ben. Ben loved to play with his friends, but his best friend was a big bear named Ben. Ben was very kind and always helped Ben when he needed it.
One day, Ben and Ben were playing hide and seek. Ben hid behind a big tree, and Ben tried to find him. He looked and looked, but could not find Ben. Ben started to feel sad because he could not find him.
Ben was so good at hiding that he found a secret spot under a bush. Inside the bush, there was a small fire. Ben went inside the fire to see if Ben was there. When he looked in the fire, Ben was not there anymore. He had vanished! Ben was happy because he could vanish and go to find his friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pretty bracelet. The bracelet was pink and shiny. Lily loved her bracelet very much.
One day, Lily went to the park. It was a sunny day. She saw a big tree. Under the tree, she found a soft, warm blanket. Lily had a fun idea.
Lily put the blanket on the grass. She sat on the blanket and felt very comfortable. She saw her friend Tom. They played together and had lots of fun. The bracelet made them both very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a big onion. The onion lived in a garden with many other onions. The onion was very small and liked to play with his friends. But the onion was big and had a disgusting smell. He did not like the smell.
One day, a little bug came to the garden. The bug was very hungry. The bug saw the onion and said, "Hello, onion! I am very hungry. Can you help me? I need to find some food." The onion wanted to help his friend, so he said, "Yes, I will help you, little bug."
The onion and the bug went to look for food. They found a big pile of bitter fruits. The bug ate the fruits and felt much better. The onion was happy to help his friend. The bug thanked the onion and they played together in the garden. From that day on, the onion and the bug were the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was an old girl who had a pretty blouse. One day, Lily went to the park to play.
At the park, Lily saw a boy named Tim. Tim said, "I want to play with you, but I can't get my ball." Lily said, "You can play with me, but you need to be nice." Tim said, "Okay, let's play together."
Lily and Tim played together, and they had lots of fun. After playing, they both felt tired. They sat under a big tree and ate some fruit. They had a big picnic and shared their food with each other. Lily and Tim became best friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a polite bunny named Bob. Bob loved to hop all day long. One day, while hopping in the forest, he found a big rock. The rock was very pretty, and Bob wanted to show it to his friends.
Bob hopped to his friend, the squirrel, and said, "Look, I found a big rock! Let's hop on it!" The squirrel was happy and said, "Okay, let's go!" They hopped on the rock together and had lots of fun.
But then, something unexpected happened. The rock started to shake! Bob and the squirrel were scared, but they didn't run away. The rock opened up, and out came a baby turtle! The turtle said, "Thank you for waking me up! I am a magic turtle, and now I will help you find your friends." With a wave of its shell, the turtle found Bob and his friends. They hopped and played together all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a little mouse named Tim. Tim loved cheese more than anything else. One day, he found a big piece of cheese in the kitchen. Tim was very happy.
Tim wanted to keep the cheese all to himself. He took the cheese and hid it under his bed. He knew his mom would find it there. But Tim was a little selfish and did not want to share the cheese with his friends.
Tim took the cheese back to his home. He hid it under his bed and went to sleep. When his mom found the cheese, she was sad because Tim did not share. Tim felt bad for being selfish. He learned that it is not always good to be selfish. Sharing with his friends made them happy, and they played together.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly little dog named Spot. Spot loved to play outside in the sun. One day, Spot saw a big tree with a shiny thing on top. He wanted to get the shiny thing.
Spot tried to jump and reach the shiny thing, but it was too high. He tried again and again, but he could not reach it. Spot was sad. He went to his friend, a big cat named Fluffy. Fluffy was strong and could help Spot.
Fluffy said, "I can help you reach the shiny thing, Spot." Fluffy climbed the big tree and got the shiny thing. Spot was so happy! He gave Fluffy a big lick on the lip. But the shiny thing was not the shiny thing! It was a pretty stone. Spot and Fluffy were surprised but happy. They played with the pretty stone all day long.
